plan.reason: With only 24 of 100 evaluations used and 10 stagnant steps with zero recent improvement, increase exploration moderately to escape a plateau while keeping current_to_best for reliable convergence. Auto surrogate adapts between RBF and quadratic via held-out RMSE given limited 10-D data. Moderate mutation/crossover balances diversity and exploitation; modest local_fraction/radius adds intensification without starving global search. Population 36 and 5 generations keep surrogate overhead reasonable within the fixed budget.
